title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Location: Birkenhead (on-site)
Pay: 14.50 per hour
Hours: 37 hours per week (flexible within core hours)

We are currently recruiting for a proactive and organised HR Administrator to join a well established, international organisation. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected employer known for its strong values, supportive culture, and commitment to employee development, with the potential to secure a permanent role.

The Role

This is a fast-paced and varied position, supporting the HR function with a range of administrative and employee-facing tasks. You will play a key role in ensuring processes are followed accurately and efficiently, while providing a high level of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Drafting professional correspondence, including offer letters
- Managing HR-related inbox queries, including benefits enquiries
- Supporting HR processes and maintaining process documentation
- Ensuring accurate record-keeping with strong attention to detail
- Liaising confidently with employees at all levels
- Supporting general HR administration duties

About You
- Previous HR or administrative experience (HR experience desirable)
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Conscientious and able to manage workload effectively
- Confident communicator, comfortable speaking with stakeholders
- Resilient and able to work in a busy environment
- Strong written skills with experience in professional letter drafting

Additional Information
- This is a fully site-based role (5 days per week)
- Occasional travel may be required, including visits to operational sites and quarterly team meetings (Dublin and South Wales)
- Opportunity to join a reputable organisation with a strong focus on safety, collaboration, and employee well being

title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
My client is seeking an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team in Birkenhead.The role will focus on processing supplier invoices and payments, assisting with credit card reconciliations and providing general administrative support, including vehicle administration.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Finance
- Process incoming supplier invoices, checking details against purchase orders and ensuring the correct references and cost codes are recorded.
- Obtain the necessary authorisations and process approved invoices through the relevant finance systems.
- Prepare and process weekly supplier payment runs.
- Respond to supplier queries professionally and promptly.
- Assist with credit card transaction processing and reconciliations.
- Provide general finance and administrative support as required.
- General Administration and Operational Support
- Answer incoming telephone calls and direct enquiries appropriately.
- Liaise with drivers and vehicle maintenance providers to arrange servicing and maintenance.
- Update vehicle insurance details when vehicles are exchanged.
- Check and process driver mileage claims.
- Maintain accurate records and up-to-date documentation.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- GCSEs or equivalent, including English and Maths at grade C/4 or above.
- At least three years' experience in an accounts payable role.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience using finance systems and processing supplier invoices.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and helpful approach when dealing with colleagues, suppliers and external contacts.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This role offers a basic salary of up to £29,000 depending on experience, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company pension, death in service

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Salary: Circa £28,000 FTE

Permanent Full-time or potentially part-time

Experienced in Credit Control? Looking for a fresh opportunity?

Hoot Recruit is recruiting on behalf of an established business looking for a Credit Controller to join its finance team.

We're looking for someone who knows their way around credit control, enjoys dealing with customers and is confident chasing payments while maintaining good working relationships.

You'll be joining an experienced team, working alongside an existing Credit Controller who will be on hand to provide guidance and support as they move into another position within the business.

What you'll be doing
- Managing outstanding customer payments
- Contacting customers by phone and email to chase overdue invoices
- Maintaining accurate records of payments and outstanding balances
- Resolving invoice and payment queries
- Building positive relationships with customers
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Working closely with the wider finance team to keep debtor balances under control

What we're looking for
- Previous credit control experience is essential
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Comfortable having conversations about overdue payments
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Friendly, approachable and proactive attitude

What's on offer?
- Salary circa £28,000 (pro rata for part-time)
- Permanent opportunity
- Potential flexibility around working hours
- Part-time hours may be considered, ideally spread across five days
- Support from an experienced finance team
- Stable, established business

This could be a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who wants a role where they can make a real contribution without necessarily having to manage a team.

title: Court of Protection Administrator
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking a Court of Protection Administrator to join a law firm in Wirral, Merseyside. This is a full-time, permanent job offering a salary of up to £24,500 per annum, with an increase planned for April 2027 in line with the Voluntary Living Wage. The vacancy has arisen following internal progression and offers the opportunity to support a specialist legal team with deputyship accounts, administration and Personal Injury Trust matters. In addition, the benefits include hybrid working following probation reviews, Medicash, Perkbox, free parking, 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown.Role Responsibilities

You will provide accurate and efficient administrative support to the Court of Protection and Deputyship team, working closely with colleagues and reporting to the Team Leader. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Entering and retrieving information using the firm's IT and case management systems.
- Processing approved payments from deputyship and designated client accounts on the instructions of the relevant File Handler.
- Carrying out monthly reconciliations of deputyship and designated client accounts.
- Providing administrative assistance with a caseload of execution-only Personal Injury Trusts.
- Opening and closing files, assisting with billing, scanning, filing and preparing outgoing post.
- Maintaining and updating Excel spreadsheets and other records accurately.
- Providing administrative support and cover to colleagues as directed by the Team Leader.

About You

This Court of Protection Administrator position would suit an organised, numerate and detail-focused person who enjoys being part of a team and handling confidential information carefully. You should be able to demonstrate the following:
- Good written and verbal communication skills and a professional, empathetic approach to clients.
- Strong numerical ability, attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills.
- Confidence using Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel.
- Organisational and file management skills, with the ability to work to deadlines and use your own initiative.
- Experience communicating with clients by telephone and face to face.
- A reliable, discreet, flexible and client-focused approach.
- Previous office administration experience and familiarity with electronic case management systems would be advantageous.

Salary and Benefits

The firm offers a practical benefits package alongside the opportunity to work within a specialist Court of Protection team. The successful Court of Protection Administrative Assistant will benefit from:
- Salary of up to £24,500 per annum, with an increase planned for April 2027 in line with the Voluntary Living Wage.
- Permanent, full-time employment, working 35 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays and a Christmas shutdown, with the annual leave allowance increasing to 21 days in January 2027.
- Hybrid working following probation reviews.
- Medicash healthcare cash plan and Perkbox employee benefits.
- Free car parking and a relaxed dress code.
- Weekly fruit basket and monthly breakfast.
- Workplace pension following three months' employment.

About the Law Firm

Our client is a Lexcel-accredited law firm providing Court of Protection, conveyancing and private client services. Its dedicated Deputyship team works with individuals, families and other professionals, with an emphasis on clear communication and client care. This opportunity has become available through internal progression, and the firm also highlights ongoing staff training and development.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Court of Protection Administrative Assistant job in Wirral, Merseyside, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.

title: Medical Secretary
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Medical Secretary to join our team. This vital role involves providing comprehensive administrative support within healthcare settings, ensuring smooth communication between patients, medical staff, and external agencies. The ideal candidate will possess strong office and administrative experience, demonstrating excellent attention to detail and professionalism in a fast-paced environment.

Duties
- Manage and coordinate appointment scheduling for medical practitioners and patients efficiently.
- Prepare and maintain accurate medical records, correspondence, and documentation in compliance with confidentiality standards.
- Handle incoming calls, inquiries, and correspondence promptly, providing exceptional customer service to patients and healthcare staff.
- Maintain organised filing systems both digitally and physically to facilitate quick access to information.
- Collaborate with clinical staff to ensure seamless communication and operational efficiency within the healthcare facility.

Requirements
- Proven office experience with a strong emphasis on administrative support within a healthcare environment.
- Previous experience working as a Medical Secretary and use of Medical Terminology
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to multitask effectively under pressure.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional demeanor.
- Proficiency in MS Office applications such as Word, Excel, and Outlook; familiarity with electronic health record systems is advantageous.
- Attention to detail and confidentiality are essential qualities for success in this role.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a dynamic setting.

description:

You'll gain exposure across multiple group entities, work closely with experienced finance professionals, and play an important role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the finance function.

The business based near the Wirral offers genuine opportunities for learning and development, making it an ideal move for someone looking to build on existing finance experience and progress their career.

- Daily bank postings and reconciliations
- Purchase ledger reconciliations and invoice processing
- Sales ledger reconciliation support
- Posting invoices and credit notes onto the finance system
- Preparing monthly reports and spreadsheets
- Assisting with reconciliations and month-end finance activities
- Investigating and resolving account and variance queries

- Supporting the finance team with ad-hoc projects and process improvements

- Previous experience in a finance, accounts or transactional finance role

description:

title: Document Controller
description:
Reynco Ltd is working in partnership with a well-established Construction Contracting group, who is seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Document Controller to join their expanding team. The Document Controller will provide administrative support to the Pre-Construction Team and ensure the smooth and efficient operation of all project-related activities.

Remuneration:

Salary: 30,000 - 40,000 Depending on Experience + Bonus, Pension & Additional Benefits
Location: The Wirral

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain a document control system to manage all project documentation and ensure that all files are up-to-date and accurate.
- Issuing, tracking, and logging incoming/outgoing drawings, documents and correspondence.
- Edit documentation to ensure that all documents are consistent, accurate, and comply with company standards.
- Supporting project teams with the collation of O&M manuals and As-Built documentation.
- Assist in the preparation of project proposals, bids, and contracts.
- Collaborate with the project team to develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and budgets.

Skills & Experience:

title: SHEQ Coordinator
description:
ROLE: SHEQ Coordinator
HOURS: Monday - Friday 07:00 - 15:30
SALARY: £32,000 plus excellent benefits
BENEFITS: Healthcare Cash Plan, 3x Salary Life Assurance, High Street Discounts, Staff Discount
BASE: Site Based - Vista, Wirral CH43 3 DU
Eurocell are a stock market listed Plc and the market leader for uPVC products within the building industry. We know that our people are our greatest asset, we are successful, dynamic, ambitious and looking for great team players to grow with us.
We are currently recruiting for a SHEQ Coordinator based at Vista, part of the Eurocell Group of companies, responsible for supporting the delivery of Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (SHEQ) standards.
Working closely with Production Leads and employees, the role focuses on identifying risks, preventing incidents, improving product quality, and promoting a positive culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
You will take a proactive, hands-on approach to monitoring standards, investigating issues, challenging unsafe behaviours, and coaching colleagues to ensure safe working practices are consistently followed.
WHAT OUR SHEQ COORDINATORS DO:
- Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses, implementing and monitoring corrective actions
- Conduct safety inspections, compliance audits and hazard identification activities
- Promote a positive safety culture through coaching, inductions, toolbox talks and challenging unsafe behaviours
- Develop and maintain SOPs, safety documentation and compliance records
- Monitor equipment checks, product quality standards and defect prevention measures
- Manage quality issues, including supplier non-conformances, internal rejects and customer returns
- Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance safety, compliance and product quality

WHAT WE NEED FROM OUR SHEQ COORDINATORS:
- Previous experience within a Health & Safety, Quality, or SHEQ position, ideally within manufacturing
- Strong knowledge of safe working practices and compliance requirements
- Confident in challenging unsafe behaviours and driving accountability
- Excellent communication and coaching skills
- Strong organisational and record-keeping abilities
- Good IT skills, including report writing and audit documentation
- A proactive and practical approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement

WHAT WE OFFER OUR SHEQ COORDINATORS;
- You will be rewarded with a very competitive basic salary
- 25 days holiday, plus statutory holidays - normally 33 days in total each year
- Free Healthcare plan for all employees
- Enhanced Maternity and Paternity benefit
- Free Life Assurance Plan of 3x your Annual Salary
- Christmas shutdown
- Option to join the Eurocell Share Save Scheme at discounted rates, and share in our company success
- Company Pension Plan
- Employee discount on Eurocell products
- Discounts across many well-known online and high street retailers
- A blend of training, including e-learning and on the job training to help your career development
- Care First Employee Assistance Programme, available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year for confidential support and advice, if and when you need it
- Colleague Referral Programme; we pay you for successfully referring people to join our team
- Excellent opportunities to grow with us, and progress your career

title: Recruitment Administrator
company: Wirral University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
advertiser_name: Wirral University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust
description: Recruitment Administrator 37.5 hours per week, working Monday to Friday 9am till 5pm. We have an opportunity for the right candidate to join our friendly Recruitment team - part of the HR directorate on a full time, permanent basis as an Recruitment Administrator. We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic person, who will be an integral team member of our Trust to help us carry out our future vision and promote WUTH as a great place to work. As the successful candidate will have the chance to make a real difference by providing a high quality, customer-focused recruitment service to both prospective and current employees, as well as our recruiting managers and is able to deliver this with a professional and personable approach. If you have the qualities we are looking for, then we want you to join us! Below are a few benefits you would receive while working for the NHS. 27 days annual leave + public bank holidays (raising to 33 days after 10 years service) Annual personal development review and plan to support your career aspirations Access to training courses for all staff NHS Pension NHS Discounts 1 Day working from home on a weekly rotation And a whole lot more! You will be responsible for liaising with candidates and managers, playing a proactive part in the recruitment process, providing appropriate and timely advice, information and support. You will need to have attention to detail and a flexible approach will be essential. You will be processing the full end to end recruitment process which includes: Compliance checking Advertising Internally and Externally Sending for shortlisting, Setting interviews, Issuing conditional and unconditional offers of employment Undertaking the NHS employment check standards including: verification of ID, Right to work, DBS, Occupational Health, Professional Registration/Qualifications and References Supporting and attending Recruitment Events on evenings and/or weekends You will use the Trusts selected Recruitment system (TRAC). You will also be expected to have confident and competent computer skills, with the ability to work within a team and be self-motivated. Please see attached Job Description for further information about the Recruitment Administrator position available at WUTH.
